# Nullshift

> Nullshift (legal name: Nullshift Development Ltd) is a UK development
> company that designs, builds and runs bespoke business systems —
> agentic AI automations, booking and payments platforms, client portals
> and the operations behind them. Clients own everything outright: the
> code, the data and the accounts. No per-seat SaaS fees.

## Canonical facts

- Legal name: Nullshift Development Ltd
- Trading name: Nullshift
- Companies House number: 17284213
- UK ICO data protection registration: ZC214743 (register entry:
  https://ico.org.uk/ESDWebPages/Entry/ZC214743)
- Registered office: 66 Paul Street, London, England, EC2A 4NA
- Co-Founders: Louis McKenzie (Co-Founder & Lead Developer,
  https://www.linkedin.com/in/louis-mckenzie-a287b9247) and
  Christopher Melsa (Co-Founder & Director)
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/nullshift-development-ltd
- Contact: louis@nullshift.co.uk
- Website: https://nullshift.co.uk
- Area served: United Kingdom (based), worldwide (remote)

Disambiguation: this Nullshift is the UK software development company at
nullshift.co.uk. It is unrelated to musical artists or gaming projects
that share the name.

## What Nullshift does

- Bespoke system builds: custom booking systems, payments platforms
  (Stripe / GoCardless), client portals, admin tools, automated email
  flows — built to be owned outright by the client.
- Agentic AI automation: end-to-end AI workflows that carry out real
  operational tasks, not just chat.
- Ongoing care plans (monthly, cancel any time):
  - Hosting Care — £40/month: managed hosting and infrastructure.
  - Hosting + API Care — £80/month: adds managed API usage (email, AI).
  - Build 3 — £120/month: includes 3 build items per month.
  - Build 10 — £180/month: includes 10 build items per month.
- Security & compliance: UK/EU hosting, encryption in transit and at
  rest, audit trails, and a signed Data Processing Agreement before any
  system goes live. Nullshift is ICO-registered (ZC214743).

## How engagement works

1. A free tailored plan: describe the pain points, Nullshift proposes
   what to automate and what it saves.
2. A fixed-price proposal signed in the client portal (with a DPA for
   limited companies).
3. The build, with progress visible in the client portal.
4. Optional monthly care plan for hosting, support and ongoing builds —
   collected by Direct Debit, cancel any time.
